A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same NExtLong work. Their text, figures, tables, equations and complete appendices are readable and can be matched across the formatting and organizational changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original model-training results on HELMET, RULER and LongBench v2, alongside ablations and attention analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains original model-training results, benchmark comparisons and ablation studies, including Tables 1–7.

M1.justification: Document chunking, hard-negative retrieval and interleaving, the next-token prediction objective, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. Newly documented attention handling for 512K training does not establish a method revision.

E1.justification: v2 removes the experiment using Magpie-Llama-3.3-Pro-1M-v0.1 for instruction fine-tuning from v1 Appendix A.6. Cosmopedia, FineWeb-Edu, UltraChat and the evaluation benchmarks remain represented. Needle-in-a-Haystack is relocated, not newly added.

E2.justification: The LongBench v2 comparison against GLM-4-9B, Qwen2.5-7B, Llama3.1-8B and GPT-4o-mini in v1 Table 8 is removed. The comparator sets in the retained synthesis-method, base-model and UltraChat/ProLong comparisons are unchanged.

E3.justification: The retained experiments use unchanged evaluation lengths, metrics, training budgets and model configurations. v2 Appendix C.2 newly explains packing and attention masks for the existing mixed-length training setup; it does not report revising a previously stated protocol.

E4.justification: Chunk-size, negative-selection, insertion-position and dataset-mixture ablations remain, together with attention analyses, short-text retention and Needle-in-a-Haystack testing. The removed Magpie experiment was an additional benchmark comparison, rather than a distinct ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates and averages across context lengths without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests. The added averaging explanation in Table 5 does not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: v1 Table 8's Magpie-tuned result of 30.8 and comparator scores of 30.2, 30.0, 30.0 and 29.3 disappear. All matched result tables and plotted values remain unchanged. In particular, the separate UltraChat-tuned LongBench v2 result remains 30.4 in Table 3.

T1.justification: Equations 1–12, including the loss reformulation and hard-negative-count derivation, retain their mathematical content. Expanding the ellipsis in Equation 3 is equivalent notation; no theorem, proof or formal assumption is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central claims: negative document extension strengthens long-range dependency modeling, improves benchmark performance and reduces reliance on naturally long documents.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning hard-negative difficulty, distant attention, chunking granularity and short-text retention are unchanged, as are the computational-cost qualification and future directions. The new Impact Statement adds no substantive limitation or mechanism explanation.

D1.justification: v2 Appendix C.2 specifies full attention for 512K documents and packing eight 64K documents with intra-document attention masks. v1 Appendix B.2 supplied only the mixture ratio and configuration reference. Table 5 also newly specifies context-length averaging; hyperparameter tables and the code link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to Li et al. (2025), Zhao et al. (2024, LongSkywork) and Ding et al. (2024, Fewer Truncations Improve Language Modeling), and removes the GLM reference associated with the deleted comparison. The central positioning against existing synthesis methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Most prose is retained. v2 reorders the analysis subsections, promotes Needle-in-a-Haystack to Appendix A, reorganizes subsequent appendices, and adds acknowledgements and an Impact Statement. Author-affiliation information and some wording also change.

P2.justification: Document-wide ICML reformatting changes the title block, typography, headers and float placement, while appendix prose switches from two columns to one. The former Table 8 is removed, several figures move, and the chunk-size plot loses its internal title. v2 also displays a template running header throughout.

improvement.justification: v2 improves reproducibility through explicit attention and packing instructions, but removes the Magpie-tuned comparison against four instruction models without explaining its withdrawal. The central method and retained results are unchanged. Added implementation clarity and lost supporting evidence have opposing effects whose net impact on overall quality is not reliably established.
